title: CAT 2024 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quant - Number System
subject: Quant

questions.q: For any natural number $n$, let $a_n$ be the largest integer not exceeding $\sqrt{n}$. Then the value of $a_1 + a_2 + \dots + a_{50}$ is
questions.explain: The number of integers $n$ for which $\lfloor\sqrt{n}\rfloor = k$ is given by $(k+1)^2 - k^2 = 2k + 1$. For $k=1$, there are 3 terms (sum=3). $k=2$: 5 terms (sum=10). $k=3$: 7 terms (sum=21). $k=4$: 9 terms (sum=36). $k=5$: 11 terms (sum=55). $k=6$: 13 terms (sum=78). For $k=7$, the squares start at 49. From $n=49$ to $n=50$, there are 2 terms, contributing $2 \times 7 = 14$. Total sum = $3 + 10 + 21 + 36 + 55 + 78 + 14 = 217$.
